narrative.overview: Eatlog is a serious, calm Android training tool. Its dark Material 3 surface stack keeps the user focused on energy, macros, and trend data rather than decorative fitness theatrics. Information is compact but breathable: large tabular figures establish the current state, while toned surfaces and hairline borders establish hierarchy without shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal dark Material 3 layering, not gradients or glass.
Real Onest weights and tabular numeric hierarchy.
Scanner/photo media is meaningful; icons are the fallback.
Rounded surfaces with hairline boundaries, not floating shadow stacks.

rules.name: Scanner-First Rule
rules.body: Camera capture, gallery import, and meal description are the primary entry routes. Search and manual entry remain capable fallbacks, never the visual center of the product.

rules.name: Nutrient Meaning Rule
rules.body: Protein is rose, carbs are green, fat is gold, and expenditure is lavender on every screen.

rules.name: Stable Figure Rule
rules.body: Calories, grams, dates, trend weights, and editable measurement values always use tabular numerals.

rules.name: Tonal Elevation Rule
rules.body: Use a higher surface token to distinguish an active or selected element. Never add a shadow to compensate for weak hierarchy.

dos: Do use tonal surfaces and hairline outline-variant borders.
Do gate motion through reduced-motion behavior.
Do use real scanned thumbnails with deterministic food icons as fallback.
donts: Don't add gamification noise, gradients, glassmorphism, or drop shadows.
Don't use cream/sand SaaS neutrals or mascot copy.
